verdict.rationale: Context.dev shows only glancing support for this story. Async batch jobs let you track progress until completion (docs-3), and responses carry partial-result and completion markers (docs-17, docs-25). Browser actions report which interactions succeeded (docs-7), and extraction offers grounding and coverage controls that loosely relate to data quality (docs-4). Signed change events exist, but they watch website content changes, not job failures (docs-9). Missing for 10: job performance metrics or dashboards, explicit data-quality validation, alerts or webhooks when a job fails, and any independent corroboration.
